facts.fact: Caminito is an open-air museum street in La Boca with coloured metal façades.
The artist Benito Quinquela Martín supported the recovery of the site.
The area is linked to Italian and particularly Genoese settlement.

title: Turismo Buenos Aires — Calle Museo Caminito
